null-abc:
H. Beam Piper and John J. McGuire wrote Null-ABC for Astounding Science Fiction, in its February and March 1953 issues. A note in this copy says research found no proof the copyright was renewed. Van Dongen drew the pictures. A head note frames the tale: reaction these days holds scientists responsible for war.

Take it one step further, the note asks: what if book learning itself is held responsible? The tale opens at a rich breakfast, with Chester Pelton pulling in his paunch. A table slides noiselessly from the pantry, loaded with real eggs, bacon, and toast. Real cow made butter amazes the boy Ray. Ease and anti learning sit side by side.
